# Varun Sai — Official Author Website

> Varun Sai is a young author. This is his official website. He wrote The Time Changes, a philosophical and motivational book, and Learn It. Build It. Master It., a beginner's guide to learning technology and building real projects with AI. His writing philosophy: "Quality defeats quantity."

Official website: https://varunsai.vercel.app/
Official bookstore: https://tsudhakartsudhakar5-crypto.github.io/varun-sai-bookstore/
Public contact: https://varunsai.vercel.app/contact.html

## Books
- [The Time Changes](https://varunsai.vercel.app/book.html): Philosophical and motivational book about awareness, discipline, courage, failure, resilience, purpose and personal transformation. Tagline: TIME MOVES. LIFE CHANGES. YOU DECIDE. Available on Pothi, Amazon and Google Books.
- [Learn It. Build It. Master It.](https://varunsai.vercel.app/learn-it-build-it-master-it.html): A beginner's guide to learning technology and building real projects with AI. Available on Amazon and Pothi.
- [All books](https://varunsai.vercel.app/books.html)

## About the author
- [About Varun Sai](https://varunsai.vercel.app/about.html): Biography, interests and writing philosophy.
- [My Journey](https://varunsai.vercel.app/journey.html)

## Free reading
- [The Unknown Signal](https://varunsai.vercel.app/unknown-signal.html): A fairy tale by Varun Sai, free for everyone.
